raw_text: The pro-Russia defence procurement narrative flooding Indian social media is clearly coordinated. Same talking points, same timing, same newly created accounts. India needs both Russian and Western systems for strategic balance — the binary framing is the tell that this is an influence op, not genuine analysis.
clean_text: Military analyst on Bluesky identifies coordinated pro-Russia defence procurement narrative on Indian social media as influence operation. Notes binary framing as indicator of inauthenticity.
